full_text:
Article 7-2 (Subcommittees and Advisory Group)
(1) Where necessary for the efficient performance of its duties, the Committee may establish subcommittees for different fields.
(2) The chairperson shall designate the head of each subcommittee from among commissioned members, taking into account expertise and experience.
(3) The Committee may establish and operate an advisory group consisting of relevant experts to conduct specialized reviews of matters concerning national defense reform.
